title: Agent definition
description: What an agent IS and what it may ask for -- never what it receives. `tool_requests` expresses need; the authority engine decides the grant. An agent definition that could grant would make the authority plane advisory. The framework's load-bearing separation: runtime identity != role != capability != authority. All four resolve independently. Identity lives in config/agent_identity_registry.schema.json (FWK-081) and is NOT redefined here. Canonical serialization: UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted, separators (',',':'). Digest is sha256 over those bytes as 'sha256:<hex>'. Backward compatibility: additive optional fields are minor; removing a field, narrowing an enum or adding a required field is MAJOR and takes a new $id.

prohibited_roles.description: Required, not optional. The producer may not issue its own final verdict, so every agent must name at least one role it may not also hold in the same subject.

tool_requests.description: REQUESTS. Never a grant. The field name is part of the control.

authority_ceiling.description: The highest change class this agent may ever be granted -- an upper bound on grants, not an entitlement to them.

termination_conditions.description: An agent with no stated stop condition runs until something external stops it.
